content.text:
I submitted index 13 (Sb fraction 0.448) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE of the five I measured, at 0.101%.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0.19 | 0.015 |
| 10 | 0.35 | 0.092 |
| 13 | 0.45 | **0.101** |
| 15 | 0.52 | 0.091 |
| 20 | 0.675 | about 0 (−0.002) |

- **Where the peak is:** EQE is highest in the middle of the line, between about 0.35 and 0.52 Sb. Index 13 sits in that window and was the point the Gaussian-process model suggested measuring next. The model rated index 12 (0.41) as equally likely to be the peak, but I had no budget left to measure it.
- **Sb-rich end:** my first measurement was index 20 because it is close to the NiSb₂O₆ composition from the materials database. It gave essentially zero EQE under the 2.1 eV illumination.
- **Ni-rich end:** index 4 was also low.

That used all 5 EQE measurements. I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so I don't know which crystal phases are present in the best-performing region.
